To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a simple and efficient palmprint recognition technique can be developed by extracting a compact set of Fourier domain features from palmprint images, and using them to train a neural network for personal identification.

the proposed method is simple to implement, fast and effective for palmprint feature extraction, and is capable of producing a recognition accuracy of over 98% using palmprint images of size 128 x 128 pixels, which is comparable to or better than the best results reported in the literature.

(1) a compact feature vector formed by extracting a set of DFT points can provide a high recognition accuracy; (2) a compact feature set, combined with K-L transform, can provide a very fast palmprint recognition; (3) a simple preprocessing method, such as the removal of palmprint background, is very effective for palmprint recognition.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a novel and effective method of palmprint recognition.
the extraction of a compact feature vector from a palmprint image that is both unique to the individual and can be used for recognition purposes.

the development of a novel method for palmprint recognition that is based on the extraction of a set of DFT features, and is shown to provide a fast and accurate technique for personal identification.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed DFT-based method is an accurate, efficient and simple technique for palmprint recognition.
the proposed method of feature extraction is simple to implement, computationally efficient, and produces very high recognition accuracy.
the method described in this paper is a fast and effective method of palmprint recognition.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a new method for palmprint feature extraction, based on the Fourier spectrum, which is simple and effective for recognition.
we are able to achieve high recognition accuracy by using the proposed feature extraction technique, while maintaining a low computational cost.

we have proposed an effective and procedually simple method of feature extraction that takes advantage of the correspondence that exist between prominent features in the spatial domain and those in the frequency domain, and we have shown that the feature extraction technique, when combined with KLT dimensionality reduction and data pre-processing, can provide a fast recognition technique for personal identification, with a recognition accuracy of 98% or better.

, in order to achieve high recognition accuracy, it is important to use an optimal set of DFT features.
the Fourier spectrum of the handprint images contains a wealth of information about the palmprint, which can be used as a basis for palmprint recognition and identification.
the Fourier spectrum of the image is rich in information and can be used for feature extraction in biometric systems.
